## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and the issue or task link. For a stacked PR, list its dependencies and identify the changes introduced here.

## Ownership and integration

Name the owning team and affected teams. Link the contract or feature README and describe any compatibility changes.

## Database impact

Write “None” when the database is unaffected. Otherwise list the migration, affected shared models and consumers, and any backfill or rollout steps. Record which existing data and fresh databases were tested.

## Verification

List commands run, results, and checks still pending. Add screenshots for visible changes when useful.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Feature boundaries and server/client separation respected
- [ ] Authorization and input validation addressed where relevant
- [ ] Tests and documentation updated where relevant
- [ ] Requested review from two people in different groups outside the author's group and included affected owners where needed
- [ ] No secrets committed
